overview_description.description: We help infrastructure teams accelerate Infrastructure as Code deployments from days to minutes with AI-powered Infra as Code PR reviews. Our AI IaC PR reviews give your team complete visibility and contextual feedback on what real-time changes, risks, and issues will occur in your IaC deployment pipeline. Before you deploy, Terracotta comments on every IaC PR created, detecting and fixing drift, misconfigurations, security vulnerabilities, blast radius, and more.
